proposed_new.dairy: yogurt, cheese, milk — 20+ observed rows with no honest existing category
proposed_new.sweets: ice cream, Thai sweets, cake, chocolate — no existing category
proposed_new.prepared: composed single-plate dishes (rice bowls, wraps, pizza, sushi) — neither a single ingredient nor a category
proposed_new.condiments: dipping sauces, chili oil, gravies, oils — 15+ observed rows; small saucer/cruet studies

categories.note: New categories need a label entry in FoodArtwork.swift categoryLabels (impl lane, #260/#241 follow-up); without it the resolver falls back to the capitalized category id, which is acceptable.

fallbacks_proposed.reason: category exists with one food and no fallback; pork/blood/clear soups currently drop to neutral

fallbacks_note: Fallbacks are NOT counted toward the 100 identities. They are optional owner decisions; if declined, those rows resolve to neutral.

batches.1: Observed high-frequency + the issue's named gap classes (pork gravy, Chinese kale, linguine)
batches.2: Observed 2–4 rows + top everyday Thai staples
batches.3: Observed 1 row + Thai/Western staples the app realistically sees
batches.4: Zero-row staples that close the ≥100 target (fruit, drinks, Western fast food, sweets)
batches.5: Reserve — owner promotes or cuts; not required for ≥100
